Numi is a family-owned business that creates the highest quality products and generates profits to maximize social and environmental impact in the world. Our business model is founded on deep partnerships that go beyond transactional relationships. We source the purest tea leaves, herbs, and flowers, celebrating the knowledge and traditions of those communities who help bring our tea into the world. We’re dedicated to regenerative organic agriculture and sustainable packaging in order to positively impact the planet for generations to come.
